name: Pricedog - Amazon Price tracker & Cosmetic ingredients checker
description:
Track price history, Check cosmetic ingredients risk, Search similar products by image on Amazon, Walmart, Pinterest, Instagram and more!

Pricedog can help you save money and time when shopping online. 


✓ History price checker 

View how much an item has sold for in the past to avoid overpaying. 


✓ Image search for similar items 

Find lower prices for similar items based on image search for Amazon, Walmart, Pinterest, Instagram and more. 


✓ Automatic coupon code finder 

Automatically search for coupons at checkout to save you money. 


✓ Price drop alerts 

Receive email notifications when item drops in price.
